item.title: Inquiry Committee Formed, Assistant Professor suspended in GDC Doda suicide case

item.title: Tight Security deployed on NH-44, Kulgam ahead of Republic Day
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 21: Ahead of Republic Day celebrations, Kulgam Police have intensified security measures along the Jammu–Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) and across various parts of Kulgam district to thwart any attempts to disturb peace and public order. A senior official said that the heightened security drive is being carried out on the directions of SSP Kulgam, Shri Anayat Ali Choudhary (IPS). item.title: CM Omar to Chair Cabinet Meeting in Jammu Today
item.description: Jammu,Jan 22: The Jammu and Kashmir Cabinet, headed by Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, is scheduled to meet this morning at the Civil Secretariat, Jammu, with several key policy and administrative matters lined up for discussion. Highly placed sources said that the Cabinet is likely to clear the new Excise Policy for 2026–27, as the current policy ends on March 31, 2026. item.title: University Employee found Hanging inside Campus in Jammu Kashmir
item.description: Jammu,Jan 22: A male employee of Jammu University was found hanging from a tree inside the university campus on Thursday morning, officials said, triggering shock among staff and students. The deceased has been identified as Balwan Singh, a middle-aged resident of Hiranagar and an employee of the MBA Department of Jammu University. item.title: Srinagar Administration prepared for Rain, Snowfall: DC Srinagar
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 22: Deputy Commissioner Srinagar, Akshay Labroo on Thursday said that the administration is fully prepared in view of the forecast for heavy rain and snowfall across Jammu and Kashmir. Speaking with reporters on the sidelines of a function, Akshay Labroo said that “we are only waiting for snow. item.description: Srinagar,Jan 23: Strong and gusty winds swept across Jammu and Kashmir from Thursday evening, causing widespread property damage, disrupting electricity supply and triggering safety alerts from authorities, officials, and local reports said. item.title: CM Omar to review Weather Impact as Power Supply Drops sharply
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 23: Power supply across the Kashmir Valley was severely disrupted on Friday after active load dropped to below 100 megawatts against the usual demand of around 1,700 megawatts, following widespread damage to the electricity network caused by extreme weather conditions.
